name: Identity document
description: A passport, national ID card or residence card issued by a government to the caregiver. Shows a photo, the holder's full name, date of birth and a printed expiry date.

name: Employment contract
description: An agreement between the agency as employer and the caregiver as employee: job title, pay, working hours, signed by both. Either states an end date or says the employment is open-ended. Not an agreement with a client.

name: Background check certificate
description: An official certificate stating whether the caregiver has a criminal record, issued by a government or authorised checking body. Shows an issue date; usually no printed expiry.

name: Care qualification certificate
description: A certificate or diploma awarding the caregiver a vocational qualification in care, issued after a course of study. Shows the qualification title and award date; does not expire. Not a short first-aid or annual refresher course.

name: First aid certificate
description: A certificate confirming the caregiver completed first aid training, often including CPR. Shows a printed expiry or "valid until" date.

name: Annual training record
description: A record of mandatory refresher training completed in a given year, typically listing several topics such as safeguarding, moving and handling, infection control, medication. Shows a completion date. Not a qualification and not a first-aid certificate.

name: Service agreement
description: An agreement between the agency and the client (or their representative) for the provision of care: services, fees, terms. Either states an end date or says it runs until terminated. Not an employment contract.

name: Care plan
description: A document describing the client's care needs and how they will be met: daily support, routines, preferences, goals. Shows the date it was written or last reviewed. Not a risk assessment.

name: Risk assessment
description: A document identifying risks to the client or to staff in the client's home, such as falls, the home environment or lifting, and the measures to reduce them. Shows an assessment date. Not a care plan.

name: Consent form
description: A form signed by the client or their legal representative agreeing to care, to the sharing of their information, or both. Shows a signature and date; does not expire.

name: Emergency contact form
description: A form listing people to contact in an emergency: names, relationship to the client, phone numbers. Often includes the client's doctor.
